ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a rhombus labeled LMPQ, with L at the lower left, M below and slightly to the right, P at the upper right, and Q at the upper left. The diagonal QM is drawn in the figure, and the target angle ∠LQM is located at point Q, formed by side QL and diagonal QM. The length of side MP is also marked as 10 in the figure, but it is not shown as participating in the angle calculation. Reasoning: In rhombus LMPQ, opposite angles are equal, so ∠QLM = ∠QPM. According to the problem, m∠QLM = 2x^2 - 10, m∠QPM = 8x, therefore 2x^2 - 10 = 8x. Solving gives 2x^2 - 8x - 10 = 0, that is, x^2 - 4x - 5 = 0, so x = 5 or x = -1. x = -1 would produce a negative angle, which does not conform to the meaning of the problem, therefore x = 5. Thus ∠QLM = ∠QPM = 8x = 40°. A rhombus is also a parallelogram, and adjacent interior angles are supplementary, so ∠LQP = 180° - 40° = 140°. The diagonals of a rhombus bisect the vertex angles, QM bisects ∠LQP, therefore m∠LQM = 140° ÷ 2 = 70°.

raw_record.question_text: In rhombus LMPQ, $m\angle QLM = 2x^2 - 10$, $m\angle QPM = 8x$, and $MP = 10$. Find $m\angle LQM$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a rhombus with vertices L bottom-left, M bottom-right, P upper-right, Q upper-left, with diagonal QM drawn and the target angle LQM located at Q between QL and QM. From the text, use m∠QLM = 2x^2 - 10 and m∠QPM = 8x; MP = 10 is a side length shown but is not needed for the angle computation. Since LMPQ is a rhombus, opposite interior angles are congruent, so ∠QLM = ∠QPM. Set 2x^2 - 10 = 8x, giving x = 5 as the valid angle-producing solution. Thus ∠QLM = ∠QPM = 40°. Adjacent angles in a rhombus/parallelogram are supplementary, so ∠LQP = 140°. A rhombus diagonal bisects the vertex angles, and QM is the diagonal through Q, so ∠LQM = 140°/2 = 70°.

图像描述：图中是一个标为 LMPQ 的菱形，L 在左下，M 在下方偏右，P 在右上，Q 在左上。图中画出了对角线 QM，并且目标角 ∠LQM 位于点 Q，由边 QL 和对角线 QM 形成。图中还标出边 MP 的长度为 10，但没有显示它参与角度计算。
推理：在菱形 LMPQ 中，对角角相等，所以 ∠QLM = ∠QPM。由题意，m∠QLM = 2x^2 - 10，m∠QPM = 8x，因此 2x^2 - 10 = 8x。解得 2x^2 - 8x - 10 = 0，即 x^2 - 4x - 5 = 0，所以 x = 5 或 x = -1。x = -1 会产生负角度，不合题意，因此 x = 5。于是 ∠QLM = ∠QPM = 8x = 40°。菱形也是平行四边形，相邻内角互补，所以 ∠LQP = 180° - 40° = 140°。菱形的对角线会平分顶角，QM 平分 ∠LQP，因此 m∠LQM = 140° ÷ 2 = 70°。

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as rhombus LMPQ with triangle LQM visible inside it: LQ and LM are two sides of the rhombus, and QM is a diagonal. From the text, use the given expressions for the opposite angles at L and P: m∠QLM = 2x^2 - 10 and m∠QPM = 8x. Because opposite angles in a rhombus are equal, solve 2x^2 - 10 = 8x, giving valid x = 5, so ∠QLM = 40°. Now focus only on triangle LQM. Since LQ and LM are sides of the rhombus, LQ = LM, so triangle LQM is isosceles with vertex angle at L equal to 40°. Therefore its two base angles at Q and M are equal, and each is (180° - 40°)/2 = 70°. Hence m∠LQM = 70°.
